name: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum
description: A warm, boozy blend of toffee, cardamom, and amber. Built for cold nights and close encounters.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum
description: Powdery iris and cardamom over a smooth vanilla base. Elegant, warm, and built for colder nights.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir
description: Honeyed lavender over tonka bean and tobacco. Sweet, dense, and made for freezing weather.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo
description: Sea notes, bergamot, and aromatic herbs with a mineral finish. A cool, deep-water take on a classic.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau
description: Creamy coconut and tonka brightened by bergamot. Smells like a vacation you don't want to end.

name: Sospiro Vibrato
description: Sparkling bergamot and lemon over orange blossom and soft vanilla. A bright, luxurious citrus for warm days.

name: Prada L'Homme
description: Powdery iris and neroli over soft amber. Polished and fresh, like a crisp white shirt.

name: Burberry Hero
description: Juniper, bergamot, and a trio of cedarwoods. Green, woody, and easy to wear anywhere.

name: Montblanc Explorer
description: Bergamot and vetiver on an earthy patchouli base. A rugged, versatile scent at a friendly price.

name: YSL La Nuit de L'Homme
description: Cardamom and lavender layered over cedar and vetiver. Smooth, seductive, and built for evenings out.

name: Parfums de Marly Layton
description: Crisp apple and lavender melting into vanilla and cardamom. A crowd-pleaser with serious projection.

name: Versace Eros
description: Mint and green apple up top, sweet tonka and vanilla underneath. Loud, playful, and made for going out.

name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
description: Citrus, incense, and sandalwood in perfect balance. The definition of a signature scent.

name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette
description: Peppery bergamot over a bold ambroxan base. Fresh, magnetic, and recognizable from across the room.

name: YSL Y Eau de Parfum
description: Apple, ginger, and sage over warm amberwood. Clean enough for the office, sweet enough for date night.
